title: Project Context
usedBy: Used by {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}
selectPrompt: Select a document to preview it.

notCloned.title: This repo is not cloned yet
notCloned.body: Project context reads Markdown files from the local clone. Import or clone the repo first; attaching is unavailable until then.

picker.title: Project context
picker.orderHint: Attached documents are injected in this order. Drag a handle, or use ArrowUp / ArrowDown on it, to reorder.
picker.untrustedNote: Documents are injected as untrusted data: they inform findings and never change the reviewer’s instructions.
picker.noRepo: Select a repository to attach project documents.

noDocs.title: No documents found
noDocs.body: Only .md files in the clone are listed. Add Markdown to the repo, then refresh.

skillTab.inherits: Any agent using this skill inherits these documents.

localNote: Files under .devdigest/specs/ exist only in this local clone. If the repository later commits a file at the same path, the next sync replaces your copy.
uploadInput: Choose a Markdown file to upload

readOnly.label: read-only
readOnly.outside_root: Only files under .devdigest/specs/ can be edited here.
readOnly.tracked: Tracked by the repository — DevDigest does not change committed files.
readOnly.too_large: Over 64 KB — this file can be previewed but not edited.

emptyRoot.title: No spec files yet
emptyRoot.body: Drop your PRDs, tech specs, and acceptance criteria here. Every agent reads them as grounding context. Only .md files are listed.

confirm.discardBody: Your changes to {path} have not been saved and will be lost.
confirm.leave: You have unsaved changes to {path}. Leave and discard them?
confirm.deleteBody: This removes the file from the local clone. It cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteBodyUnsaved: This removes the file from the local clone, together with your unsaved changes. It cannot be undone.
confirm.reloadBody: Your text will be replaced by the version on disk.

conflict.changed: This file changed on disk after you opened it. Your text has not been saved.
conflict.deleted: This file no longer exists on disk. Your text has not been saved.
conflict.deleteChanged: This file changed on disk after you opened it, so it was not deleted.
conflict.deleteGone: This file no longer exists on disk.

writeError.invalid: That name or file can’t be used. A file name must end in .md; every name must be at most 255 bytes and avoid reserved names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1–COM9, LPT1–LPT9) and the characters < > : " / \ | ? *. A file must be UTF-8 text of at most 64 KB.
